title: Building Agentic Document Intelligence Pipelines: Creating Scientific Figures with AutoFigure
summary: This tutorial explores AutoFigure, a practical toolkit for generating professional scientific figures directly from text descriptions and research papers. We walk through setting up the environment, configuring an API-backed generation workflow, and converting complex document intelligence pipelines into publication-style diagrams, complete with custom reference styling and gallery exports.
